d.title: Urusei Yatsura: The Shougaibutsu Suieitaikai
syn: Urusei Yatsura: Za Shougaibutsu Suiei Taikai
Urusei Yatsura: The Obstacle Course Swim Meet
It's a Rumic World: Urusei Yatsura
d.synopsis: On a very hot summer day in Tomobiki town, Lum, Ataru, and the rest of the gang are looking forward to using the school's pool. But the teachers have other plans: setting a ludicrous obstacle course between the students in their swimsuits and the pool... naturally this ends in complete chaos.
